findings.highlight: What about the match is decided!?
findings.evidenceJa: 勝敗が決したがどうした
findings.governingReading: Shirou demands to know why a decided outcome should make him retreat.
findings.explanation: The English is grammatically malformed and obscures the defiant “so what?” relation.

findings.highlight: the chair I was lying on
findings.evidenceJa: 横になっていた長椅子
findings.governingReading: Shirou rises from the long bench on which he had been lying.
findings.explanation: The English changes a chapel bench into a chair.

findings.highlight: if I keep her buried for a day
findings.governingReading: Kotomine jokes that leaving Rin buried overnight should restore her sharp tongue.
findings.explanation: The English changes one night to a full day.
